summary: Accept both st3 and fractal client API versions in iOS pairing, renewal and Fabric gateway proof readers.

replay.detail: No replay or historical data rewrite.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination change.

compatibility.detail: iOS accepts st3.client.v0 and fractal.client.v0 permanently, and Fabric protection proofs accept both client.error.v0 namespaces independently. Request writers and API_VERSION defaults are unchanged.

manual.detail: Ship these readers to installed iOS builds before server version writers change; every client artifact must reach enrolled devices before W1 (#6209).

recovery.detail: Legacy writers and stored profiles remain unchanged.
